command: new vis.Network(<div 1200x900>, { nodes: file.nodes, edges: file.edges }, file.options); once("stabilizationIterationsDone"); stopSimulation(); net.renderer._redraw() onto an svgcanvas Context
how: vis-network draws with Canvas 2D only. At the snapshot point (observed.snapshotAt), its own CanvasRenderer._redraw ran once with net.canvas.getContext returning an svgcanvas context, so every draw call vis-network made (edges, nodes, arrows, labels) was recorded as SVG at the view vis-network itself chose. The svgcanvas context is corrected where it departs from a canvas (SVG_CONTEXT in web-oracle.mjs): the current path survives save() and fillText(), a text keeps its blanks (xml:space), a Path2D argument is replayed (with the paths added to it), a clip keeps its evenodd rule, gradients and 1-wide or dashed strokes follow the transform, and a text outline is not scaled twice; each was checked against Chromium's own screenshot of the same drawing. A shadow (shadowColor, shadowBlur, shadowOffsetX / Y) is recorded as an feDropShadow filter in device pixels. Not recorded: globalCompositeOperation (a Cytoscape.js double border draws as one ring); a glyph the pinned fonts lack (a vis-network icon) rasterizes as a box where Chromium draws nothing.

canvas.background: none (the page behind it is white)

determinism: Math.random seeded (mulberry32, seed 1) and Date.now stopped at 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z before the library loads; pinned fonts (visual-fonts/fonts.conf); nothing removed from the SVG
png: tools/rasterize.mjs (resvg-js 2.6.2, over white, fonts from visual-fonts/fonts)

drawn.about: vis-network's own account of where it drew each node, for naming the SVG's shapes: each node's id, its center (net.getPositions() through net.canvasToDOM) and its bounding box's width and height and its corners (box: net.getBoundingBox through net.canvasToDOM; the box holds a label drawn below the shape, so it is not centered on the node), in the SVG's pixels
